summary: Wiz researchers found two open ports leading to a publicly accessible ClickHouse database belonging to Chinese AI company DeepSeek that required no authentication and allowed full database control. It held over a million lines of log streams containing chat history, secret keys/API secrets, backend details and operational metadata, and could have let an attacker escalate privileges in DeepSeek's environment. Wiz found it within minutes of starting its research in late January 2025 and DeepSeek secured it promptly after disclosure.
